name: Proven Handaxe
description: A close-fighting axe with an Elarith head and a Silverbark Ash haft, given as heirloom by the small number of houses that maintain a wild-proving tradition. Each axe is marked discreetly on the underside of the haft with a sigil recognizable to the giver's house, and the same axe may pass through several generations of an honored line.
narrative_effects: Carries the same combat mechanics as a standard handaxe; its weight is in what it signals, not in what it does.
The Silverbark haft absorbs impact shock more cleanly than dense realm hardwoods, reducing hand fatigue across a long day's work.

Not bought, not commissioned, and not common: a Proven Handaxe comes only from a house that runs a wild proving and only to an elf who has survived theirs. Visible on the belt, it announces both proving-status and house affiliation to anyone in Feywood culture who knows what they are looking at.
